question: In the phase 2 IMRT + nivolumab trial for recurrent HNSCC, what was the 1-year progression-free survival rate?

agentic.answer:
I'll search for this trial in the knowledge base.Let me search for information about this trial by looking for papers on HNSCC and nivolumab.Perfect! I found the trial. Let me read the specific paper for complete details.Based on the paper, in the phase 2 trial of IMRT + nivolumab for recurrent HNSCC (NCT03521570), **the 1-year progression-free survival rate was 61.7% (95% CI, 49.2%–77.4%)**. The trial enrolled 51 evaluable patients with locoregionally recurrent or second primary head and neck squamous cell carcinoma in previously irradiated fields and met its primary endpoint (P = .002) compared to a historical control benchmark of 43.8%.

Reference: [PMID:38780927](papers/38780927.html)

Based on the phase 2 IMRT + nivolumab trial for recurrent or second primary head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, the **1-year progression-free survival (PFS) rate was 61.7% (95% CI, 49.2%-77.4%)** (PMID:38780927).

This result was statistically significant, as it rejected the null hypothesis of a 1-year PFS rate of less than 43.8% (P=.002), suggesting an improved PFS compared to historical controls.
